name: green-zone-touch-mitigated
note: plotzone + terminate.touch. Zone edges are sampled at s=0 (top=12, bottom=10). Bar 1 (high 9) and bar 2 (high 11, low 10.5) both sit clear of an edge; bar 3 (high 13, low 11) straddles the top edge, so touch fires INCLUSIVELY (design 0.5 §4) and the zone closes mitigated. Present so the harness normalizer covers the zones kind, not just levels.
source:
indicator("H", shorttitle="H", overlay=true)
plotzone(bar_index == 0, high, low, "OB", extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.touch, mitigated_color=color.gray)
